question: Should pending Skill Workshop approval prompts bind to the proposal version captured when the prompt is created and reject the decision after a revision?
rationale: The patch preserves proposal-ID-only service calls, but approval policy automatically changes existing pending-prompt semantics; code correctness and green checks cannot decide that product contract.

options.title: Bind prompt version
options.body: Fail closed after a revision and require a fresh approval prompt for the new proposal content.

options.title: Bind explicit reviews only
options.body: Keep existing approval prompts unversioned while allowing actions initiated from review output to pass an expected version.

recommendation.title: Bind prompt version
recommendation.body: Fail closed after a revision and require a fresh approval prompt for the new proposal content.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion explicitly asks this person to confirm the lifecycle contract, while Vincent Koc is the strongest current-code history owner.
